text:
holy sh*t, you can just let AI drive your browser now

Browser Use: give it a task, it opens Chrome, reads the page, clicks, types, and finishes the job

→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini or local models
→ 119K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% free and open source

github.com/browser-use/browser-use

holy sh*t, you can run ChatGPT-class models on your laptop for free

Ollama: one command, and DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, Gemma or gpt-oss are running locally — offline, private, yours

→ works on Mac, Linux, Windows
→ 185K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% free and open source

github.com/ollama/ollama

holy sh*t, your AI agents can now scrape the entire web like it's an API

Firecrawl: turn any website into clean LLM-ready markdown, JSON or screenshots — built for agents, RAG and research

→ crawl / scrape / map / extract in one SDK
→ 199K+ GitHub stars
→ open source, self-host or cloud

github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

holy sh*t, you can now hire an entire AI software company with ONE prompt

MetaGPT gives you a PM, architect, project manager and engineers, all AI agents, each doing one job and handing off like a real team

→ one line in, PRD + design + tasks + code out
→ 71K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% open source (MIT)

github.com/FoundationAgents/MetaGPT

holy sh*t, your AI agent finally stops forgetting you

Mem0 is a drop-in memory layer: it pulls the facts out of every chat, stores them, and recalls the right ones next session

→ add() + search(), a few lines of Python
→ works with OpenAI, Claude, and local LLMs
→ 68K+ GitHub stars
→ 100% open source (Apache-2.0)

github.com/mem0ai/mem0

holy sh*t, you can stop coding AI agents from scratch

Dify lets you drag an LLM, your docs, and a few tools onto one canvas, then ship it as a live agent, web app, or API

→ RAG, agents, and workflows in one place
→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Ollama
→ self-host with one docker command
→ 160K+ GitHub stars

github.com/langgenius/dify

this is f*cking wild, someone open-sourced an entire trading firm made of AI agents

TradingAgents gives one ticker to a full desk: analysts dig in, a bull and a bear argue it out, a trader makes the call, and a risk team has to sign off

→ fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical analysts run in parallel
→ works with GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and Ollama
→ backtests that only see data from that day
→ 121K+ GitHub stars

research only, not financial advice
